import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def solve_linear_system_gf2_precond (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  matrix.length > 0 ∧
  (matrix.getD 0 []).length > 0 ∧
  matrix.length = b.length ∧
  matrix.length ≤ 100 ∧
  (matrix.getD 0 []).length ≤ 100 ∧
  (∀ row, row ∈ matrix → (∀ x, x ∈ row → x = 0 ∨ x = 1)) ∧
  (∀ x, x ∈ b → x = 0 ∨ x = 1)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

def is_solution (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (x : List Nat) : Prop :=
  x.length = (matrix.getD 0 []).length ∧
  (∀ i, i < matrix.length →
    ( (List.range x.length).foldl (fun acc j => acc + (matrix.getD i []).getD j 0 * x.getD j 0) 0 ) % 2 = b.getD i 0)

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def gf2BitVectors : Nat → List (List Nat)
  | 0 => [[]]
  | n + 1 =>
      (gf2BitVectors n).map (fun xs => 0 :: xs) ++
      (gf2BitVectors n).map (fun xs => 1 :: xs)

def checkGf2Solution
    (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (x : List Nat) : Bool :=
  (x.length == (matrix.getD 0 []).length) &&
    (List.range matrix.length).all (fun i =>
      ((List.range x.length).foldl
        (fun acc j =>
          acc + (matrix.getD i []).getD j 0 * x.getD j 0) 0) % 2
          == b.getD i 0)

def searchGf2Solutions
    (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) :
    List (List Nat) → Option (List Nat)
  | [] => none
  | x :: xs =>
      if checkGf2Solution matrix b x = true then
        some x
      else
        searchGf2Solutions matrix b xs
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def solve_linear_system_gf2 (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (h_precond : solve_linear_system_gf2_precond matrix b) : Option (List Nat) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  searchGf2Solutions matrix b
    (gf2BitVectors ((matrix.getD 0 []).length))
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (result : Option (List Nat)) (h_precond : solve_linear_system_gf2_precond matrix b) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some x => is_solution matrix b x
  | none => ∀ x, x.length = (matrix.getD 0 []).length → (∀ v, v ∈ x → v = 0 ∨ v = 1) → ¬ is_solution matrix b x
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem checkGf2Solution_eq_true_iff
    (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (x : List Nat) :
    checkGf2Solution matrix b x = true ↔ is_solution matrix b x := by
  simp [checkGf2Solution, is_solution, List.all_eq_true]

theorem mem_gf2BitVectors_of
    {n : Nat} {x : List Nat}
    (hlen : x.length = n)
    (hbits : ∀ v, v ∈ x → v = 0 ∨ v = 1) :
    x ∈ gf2BitVectors n := by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero =>
      cases x with
      | nil =>
          simp [gf2BitVectors]
      | cons a xs =>
          simp at hlen
  | succ n ih =>
      cases x with
      | nil =>
          simp at hlen
      | cons a xs =>
          have hlenxs : xs.length = n := by
            simpa using hlen
          have ha : a = 0 ∨ a = 1 := by
            exact hbits a (by simp)
          have hxs : ∀ v, v ∈ xs → v = 0 ∨ v = 1 := by
            intro v hv
            exact hbits v (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hv)
          have hmem : xs ∈ gf2BitVectors n :=
            ih hlenxs hxs
          rcases ha with rfl | rfl <;>
            simp [gf2BitVectors, hmem]

theorem searchGf2Solutions_some_solution
    (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat)
    {candidates : List (List Nat)} {x : List Nat}
    (h : searchGf2Solutions matrix b candidates = some x) :
    is_solution matrix b x := by
  induction candidates with
  | nil =>
      simp [searchGf2Solutions] at h
  | cons y ys ih =>
      simp only [searchGf2Solutions] at h
      split at h
      next hy =>
        have hyx : y = x := by
          simpa using h
        subst x
        exact (checkGf2Solution_eq_true_iff matrix b y).mp hy
      next _ =>
        exact ih h

theorem searchGf2Solutions_none_no_solution
    (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat)
    {candidates : List (List Nat)}
    (hnone : searchGf2Solutions matrix b candidates = none) :
    ∀ x, x ∈ candidates → ¬ is_solution matrix b x := by
  induction candidates with
  | nil =>
      simp
  | cons head tail ih =>
      simp only [searchGf2Solutions] at hnone
      split at hnone
      next _ =>
        simp at hnone
      next hcheck =>
        intro x hx hsol
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with heq | htail
        · apply hcheck
          simpa [heq] using
            (checkGf2Solution_eq_true_iff matrix b x).mpr hsol
        · exact ih hnone x htail hsol
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond_satisfied (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (h_precond : solve_linear_system_gf2_precond matrix b) :
    solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond matrix b (solve_linear_system_gf2 matrix b h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  unfold solve_linear_system_gf2
  cases hs :
      searchGf2Solutions matrix b
        (gf2BitVectors ((matrix.getD 0 []).length)) with
  | none =>
      simp only [solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond]
      intro x hlen hbits
      exact
        searchGf2Solutions_none_no_solution matrix b hs x
          (mem_gf2BitVectors_of hlen hbits)
  | some x =>
      simp only [solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond]
      exact searchGf2Solutions_some_solution matrix b hs
  -- !benchmark @end proof
